item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find convincing positive evidence that Tshisekedi personally embraced the principle that he could lose power in a genuinely free, fair, and meaningful election. The available pro evidence is mostly procedural or self-serving: formal court validation, official claims that the poll was fair, and the fact that opposition parties still won some legislative seats. The weight of the record points the other way, especially once the October 2024 term-limit reform push is included.","evidence":[{"title":"Congo’s election commission cancels 82 candidates in disputed December polling","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-01-07","url":"https://theprint.in/world/congos-election-commission-cancels-82-candidates-in-disputed-december-polling/1913556/","summary":"CENI canceled votes for 82 legislative candidates over alleged fraud and other issues.
